focus_areas: Count and arrangement of dorsal plates (must be exactly 8)
Texture realism of calcareous plates vs. leathery girdle
Boundary sharpness between organism and rocky substrate
Absence of anatomical impossibilities (e.g., extra limbs, eyes)
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the count of the dorsal plates; AI often fails to maintain the specific count of 8 for chitons. Verify if the texture of the girdle looks like synthetic noise or realistic leather. Check if the shadowing under the girdle suggests proper contact with the rock.
image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a chiton (marine mollusk) clinging to a rough, dark rocky substrate. The organism has an elongated oval shape with a distinct dorsal armor consisting of eight overlapping calcareous plates (valves) surrounded by a reddish-brown leathery girdle. The plates are beige/tan with visible growth lines and texture. The background consists of wet rock with some small encrusting organisms.
